title: Micros
description: A monetary amount as an integer count of micros of the stated currency, where one unit equals 1000000 micros. Each amount is paired with a sibling `currency` field or inherits one from the enclosing auction block.
$comment: Integer representation is required. Binary floating point cannot represent decimal fractions exactly, and accumulated error in a settlement ledger is unrecoverable. Micros give six decimal places of headroom against a CPM divided by 1000 to reach a per-impression price.
